response.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING AVG(HGB) IS NOT NULL), o AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) AS overall FROM Laboratory), a AS (SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb, p.avg_hgb - o.overall AS diff_overall FROM p, o WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.overall) SELECT ID, avg_hgb, diff_overall, avg_hgb - (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) FROM a) AS diff_from_group_avg FROM a ORDER BY diff_from_group_avg DESC LIMIT 10
